_comment: Hard coded descriptions of well-known ports, software, user accounts and operating systems. Entries may have a list of external links ({title, source, url}), shown as '"title" on source'; keep it short, 0-5 links, usually 1 or 2. Edit freely; the frontend reads this file at build time.
